card.name: Words just before calorie or energy content
card.fires_on: The word right before a calorie or energy amount, such as a verb like packed, packs, has or contain, or a number after a caloric value. It appears in nutrition and energy-content statements.

modes.label: Verb before calories
modes.description: A verb or quantity word that says a food holds calories or energy.
modes.example: because it is<< packed>> full of so many calories.

modes.label: Number after caloric value
modes.description: The space before a numeric energy value or share of heat or energy.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about energy and content, such as energy, contain and content.
card.plain: It lights up just before the text says how many calories or how much energy something holds.
